description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing and modifying news resource data within a Room database in an Android project. It includes queries for fetching news resources and their IDs based on filters, as well as methods for inserting, updating, and deleting records.

classes.name: NewsResourceDao
classes.description: Interface defining data access methods for news resources in the Room database.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Retrieves a flow of news resources matching optional filters for topic IDs and news IDs, ordered by publish date descending.

methods.name: getNewsResourceIds
methods.description: Retrieves a flow of IDs of news resources matching optional filters for topic IDs and news IDs, ordered by publish date descending.

methods.name: upsertNewsResources
methods.description: Inserts or updates a list of news resource entities in the database.

methods.name: insertOrIgnoreTopicCrossRefEntities
methods.description: Inserts a list of news resource-topic cross-reference entities, ignoring conflicts.

methods.name: deleteNewsResources
methods.description: Deletes news resource records from the database matching the provided IDs.
